svg.title: Celery multi: expand the workdir before spawning the worker
svg.desc: Illustrative HOME=/home/demo. Before: ~/tmp reaches the worker literally and triggers FileNotFoundError. After: os.path.expanduser resolves it to /home/demo/tmp. Focused detail of merged PR 10739.
svg.metadata: Source: https://github.com/celery/celery/pull/10739 ; head: 1bd1e59f2ab3cbc135461e024e6d46541075ecaa ; fixture, not production capture. Albert Sans: SIL OFL 1.1. See PROVENANCE.md.
